title: First Allagash sighting: sphere of light at Mud Pond
place_text: Mud Pond campsite, Chamberlain Lake, Allagash Waterway, Maine

tellings.quote: Uh, and a member of this other group said, "What the hell is that over there?" And we looked on the other side of the lake and here's this sphere of light and it's moving like a balloon moving very very slowly but it's like moving into this wind.

plain: In 1976, at the Mud Pond campsite on Chamberlain Lake, along the Allagash Waterway, a wilderness canoe route in Maine, someone in another camping group called out "What the hell is that over there?", and across the lake was a sphere of light moving slowly, like a balloon, but into the wind. Charlie Foltz says he saw it himself, on a trip with a man named Jim Weiner. He tells it as the first of the strange sightings on that trip, which, if true, would point to an object moving under its own power.
